name: The Hague University of Applied Sciences
summary: Hogeschool in The Hague with 13 English bachelor's, from law and European studies to UX design; computing and electronics are taught in Delft.

ib.text: A full IB Diploma (24+ points, 3 HL subjects with 12+ points between them, TOK passed) opens both the 4-year and the 3-year programmes. English at HL exempts you from an English test.

programmes.name: Applied Computer Science
programmes.about: Making machines, computers and networks work together, from embedded systems to software, in a three-year programme taught in Delft's tech hub, preparing you for high-tech firms or a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

programmes.name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering
programmes.about: Microchips, sustainable energy and intelligent hardware in a three-year Delft programme, with project work alongside semiconductor companies such as ASML.

needs.note: The maths exam must be passed.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

programmes.name: European Studies
programmes.ib: French, German or Spanish throughout, at beginner or advanced level. A separate 3-year fast track, with its own page, is open to full IB Diploma holders.
programmes.about: Business, politics and law of Europe combined with professional skills and a modern language (French, German or Spanish), plus an exchange abroad and an internship.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

programmes.name: Industrial Design Engineering
programmes.ib: You must have passed your IB Maths exam (AA or AI).
programmes.about: Designing products by co-creating with users and stakeholders, following one design process across very different projects, from playground equipment to interactive museum exhibits.

needs.note: The maths exam must be passed.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

programmes.name: International and European Law
programmes.about: International, European and private law taught in The Hague, the city of international courts, with practical legal skills such as case analysis and legal drafting from year 1. Awards a Bachelor of Laws.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.ib: Maths, Economics or Business Management passed. A separate 3-year track, with its own page, is for VWO-level diplomas such as the full IB.
programmes.about: How companies create value across borders: economics, marketing, finance, operations and supply chain, studied with classmates from 40+ countries and specialisations such as finance and accounting.

needs.note: One of Maths, Economics or Business Management passed.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

programmes.name: International Communication Management
programmes.about: Project-based training in international communication: media campaigns, reputation, conferences and influencing target groups, graduating with a portfolio of professional work. Runs in three years.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

programmes.name: International Financial Management & Control
programmes.ib: IB Maths plus Economics or Business Management passed, then a 30-45 minute interview in English. A separate 3-year track is open to full IB Diploma holders.
programmes.about: Accounting, risk management, strategy and decision-making applied to real companies, from pricing for a small brand to budgeting for a multinational.

needs.note: The maths exam must be passed.

programmes.selectionNote: An eligibility check, then a compulsory interview in English about whether the programme fits you. 2027 deadlines not yet published.

programmes.name: International Public Policy and Leadership
programmes.about: How governments and NGOs tackle climate change, inequality and human rights, learned by writing policy briefs, running campaigns and organising your own global-issues conference in year 2.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

programmes.name: Process & Food Technology
programmes.ib: The 3-year track, with its own page and open to full IB Diploma holders, needs IB Maths and Chemistry passed.
programmes.about: Chemical and food production processes studied in labs and a kitchen, from cheese-making and brewing in year 1 to sustainable, biobased products in projects set by industry.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

programmes.name: Safety and Security Management Studies
programmes.about: Terrorism, crime, industrial hazards and hybrid threats: assessing risks and managing security, with an optional minor in intelligence collection and analysis.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

programmes.name: Sport Studies | International Sport Management
programmes.ib: An interview is a compulsory part of the application.
programmes.about: How sport is managed and why it matters to society, with leadership training and the idea of sport as a driver of social change running through a three-year programme.
programmes.selectionNote: An eligibility check, then a compulsory interview in English about whether the programme fits you. 2027 deadlines not yet published.

programmes.name: User Experience Design
programmes.about: Designing with technology around what people really need, beyond screens and apps, tackling questions such as liveable cities and a green future through hands-on experiments.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the entry requirements and you are admitted. 2027 deadlines not yet published; in 2026 EU/EEA applicants could apply until late July.

notes: European Studies, International Business, Financial Management & Control and Process & Food Technology each run a 4-year and a faster 3-year track, and a full IB Diploma qualifies you for either.

Six degrees (Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Design, Communication, Sport Management, UX Design) run only as 3-year programmes for VWO-level diplomas, which a full IB Diploma meets.
THUAS has not yet published its 2027 deadlines; for 2026 entry non-EU applicants had to apply by 1 May and EU/EEA applicants by 31 July (2026 dates).
